name: Credential Security Remediation
description: Found and fixed a critical vulnerability where user passwords were persisted in plaintext, then hardened the surrounding auth path across the API and database layers.
impact: Removed plaintext credential storage from a production ERP system

name: AI Training Workflow Platform
description: Internal web platform supporting AI training workflows — roughly 10 REST endpoints built from scratch with a Java MVC structure and DTO layers, plus tuned Elasticsearch indexing and relevance scoring.
impact: Improved search accuracy and retrieval performance for training data

name: Enterprise ERP REST Modules
description: Enterprise REST APIs for ERP modules delivered end-to-end while preserving backward compatibility, alongside SQL query optimisation and SonarQube-driven quality work.
impact: Faster data-intensive workflows and higher unit-test coverage

name: This Portfolio Dashboard
description: Role-aware portfolio built as an admin dashboard — three tailored dashboards, a mock API playground with a gamification layer, and a JSON-driven content architecture, statically exported to GitHub Pages.
impact: Fully static, zero-backend, redeploys from a JSON edit

name: ACM Publication
description: Peer-reviewed paper published in the ACM Digital Library.
impact: Published in the ACM Digital Library
